subject: Re: PoC / Trial plan — deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: PoC / Trial plan — deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) — post-call recap

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on the primary goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock timelines: 

What we heard
- Primary objective: integrate LLM inference into Acme Support Assist to reduce resolution time and automate triage.
- Key constraint: any production traffic touching PII or customer data must be isolated / audited.
- Perf target: 99th percentile latency < 250ms for short-form responses; throughput target ~150–200 req/s for peak.

Initial deployment options we covered
1) Hosted API (fastest to validate; no infra commit)
2) Dedicated (reserved GPU pool for predictable throughput and lower per-token cost)
3) Private VPC / on-prem (required only if access to sensitive customer data is needed)

Proposed PoC approach
- Week 1–2: Hosted trial using anonymized/synthetic prompt set to validate latency, routing, and basic quality.
- Week 3–6: If perf/cost profile looks good, move to a Dedicated pilot in your staging environment (reserved capacity) to validate throughput and autoscale behavior.
- Parallel: scope Private VPC work if security team confirms need for data plane isolation (estimate 3–4 weeks once infra approvals are in).

Ask from you
- Confirm which of the three options is a hard requirement vs preference (Hosted ok for initial validation?).
- Provide success criteria owners (who will sign off on latency, quality, and security acceptance?)
- Target kickoff week for Hosted trial (we have availability starting Apr 4).

Attached is a short PoC plan (redwood-poc-plan-acme-v1.pdf) with milestones and required stakeholders. I’ll follow up with a revised plan and SOW once we confirm scope.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: PoC / Trial plan — deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) — post-call recap

Thanks Ben — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Short answer on deployment: Hosted would be acceptable for an initial functional validation (anonymized data only). However, for any pilot that touches production or sensitive customer PII we will require either Dedicated with strict network egress controls or Private VPC. Our security team prefers Private VPC but understands that takes longer.

- Stakeholders:
  - App owner / signoff: Tom Ruiz (cc'd)
  - Security lead: Raj Patel (cc'd)
  - Procurement: procurement@acme-corp.com
  - Infra (for VPC/on-prem): team TBD but we'll loop them in if we move that route.

- Timeline: target for an initial Hosted trial kickoff Apr 5–6 would be ideal. Goal is to have Dedicated pilot scoped by end of April if the Hosted trial shows promising perf/cost.

- Success metrics (high level):
  - Latency: 99p < 250ms (short responses)
  - Quality: macro F1 on triage classification > 0.85 vs manual labels
  - Cost: unit inference cost that projects to < $0.015 per support ticket handled (will need Redwood to help model cost assumptions)

Please update the PoC plan with these items and a concrete SOW we can hand to procurement. Also can you indicate expected Dedicated sizing (gpus / instance types) for the 200 req/s target?

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee | Director, Product — Support Systems
Acme Corp
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-corp.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC / Trial plan — deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) — proposed next steps & sizing

Great — thanks for the clarity, Sam. Attached is an updated PoC plan (redwood-poc-plan-acme-v2.pdf) that incorporates the success metrics and the proposed timeline. High-level responses to your asks below:

1) Hosted trial kickoff
- We can start Apr 5. Hosted trial will use anonymized traffic you provide (or our synthetic set) and includes logging, tracing, and a simple eval harness to measure latency and classification F1.

2) Dedicated sizing (estimate for pilot)
- For 150–200 req/s of short-form inference (typical 128–256 token output), recommended starting point: 2x NVIDIA A10G equivalent GPUs in a dedicated pool with our autoscale configured to add 1 extra node at 70% utilization.
- Expected 99p latency under this config: ~120–220ms depending on prompt complexity and batching window.

3) Private VPC
- Work required: VPC peering, customer-managed routes + KMS integration, and onboarding of Private control plane. Rough lead time: 3–4 weeks from infra approval.

4) Costs & SOW
- Draft trial SOW attached (redwood-trial-sow-draft.docx). For Dedicated pilot we will provide an estimated monthly committed price vs pay-as-you-go; I'll share detailed numbers in the SOW.

Next steps (proposed)
- You: confirm Apr 5 Hosted kickoff and who will provide anonymized sample data.
- We: schedule 60-min kickoff + infra/SE sync (Jordan to run technical onboarding).
- Procurement: review draft SOW and we’ll iterate.

If that looks okay I’ll lock the calendar invites for Apr 5 and send the onboarding checklist.

Cheers,
Ben
